notes.title: Version 1.24 out now!
notes.content:
This update adds a few new goodies and squishes several bugs. The Serious Sam community really came together to help out with this one. People were throwing new ideas at us, they told us about some bugs they found, and they even shared some art with us

New stuff:
[olist]
[*] UI improvements - Menus can now be navigated using a keyboard or gamepad. We even added hover feedback for mousing over buttons
[*] Added the 'Processed' head (Thanks Tartal!)
[*] The current head gets saved between game sessions 
[/olist]

Bug fixes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed several issues for ultrawide monitors. The menu background should properly cover the whole screen and buttons should be sized more appropriately
[*] Made an attempt at fixing the flat bomb/grenade bug
[*] Only open the quit menu when you're in the main menu
[*] Don't allow pausing the game when you're blowing up Sam
[*] Fixed being able to blow up the kamikaze in the logo too quickly
[*] Fixed the spinning mouse icon (supposedly turning on the Unity splash screen fixes this?? So now you'll see a Unity splash screen)
[/olist]

Big shout out to the Serious Sam community for the help! As always, if you have any feedback or want to report a bug please reach out to us in [url=https://discord.gg/gNvkkpR5At]Discord[/url].

Be-Rad

notes.title: Serious Sam Kamikaze Attack Lands on Steam With a Bang
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

I have explosive Serious Sam news to share with you. Serious Sam: Kamikaze Attack! has launched on Steam! The game was first released 10 years ago on mobile as a part of the Serious Sam indie series, but over time the game slowly disappeared from the stores. As the game’s developer it was painful to see it fade away. Fans have been sending in requests to keep the game alive and it was haunting me that I couldn’t revive the game until now. I’ll finally be able to rest peacefully knowing the hordes of headless kamikazes are back at their jobs of chasing down Serious Sam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1623420/Serious_Sam_Kamikaze_Attack/

It’s an honor to bring Serious Sam: Kamikaze Attack! to Steam for you to play. If you have any questions or want to chat about the game please feel free to post in the game’s community group or join Croteam’s Discord server.

Thanks for playing!

Brad Johnson
Be-Rad Entertainment

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rOvbHwicQdU

notes.title: Hellooooo
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Be-Rad Entertainment is new to Steam and I've been silent so far so I wanted to say hi.

We're launching Serious Sam: Kamikaze Attack! very soon and we have Demon's Mirror in the pipeline so it seemed like a fitting time to get all the various Steam pages/groups/etc set up.

We have a big fat zero for our follower count right now. It's hilarious to see it. 

Our goal is to get 5 followers this week. It's a [i]tiny[/i] goal, but one I'm confident we can achieve.

I'll start giving more regular updates on our games now that things are a little more set up. Thanks for reading.

See you in 5 followers!

Be-Rad
